verdict.rationale: 2FAS Auth's browser extension pairs with the mobile app to deliver TOTP tokens directly in the login tab without retyping, confirmed via mobile app tap, and 2FAS Pass's browser extension explicitly supports Auto-fill and passkey-adjacent item access confirmed via the app. Missing for 10: independent hands-on user reviews confirming smooth autofill UX and explicit passkey autofill documentation (evidence focuses on TOTP and vault items, not passkeys specifically).
